messages:
maya: Noticed a customer confusion thread: their dashboard shows route X with quota 5k/day but real requests are throttled earlier when routed to the accelerator pool. Console only shows the route override number, not the effective attribution. Can we add a single-view that explains quota attribution + routing affinity per route?

tonY: +1 from infra perspective. Two separate problems: (1) effective quota computation (how route override + account cap combine), (2) routing affinity (which pool a request will land on given load/selector). We should avoid a heavy compute on list pages.

rachel: Product: propose a compact per-route badge "Quota: 5k (effective: 3.2k)" with a modal that breaks down sources: account cap, route override, burst allowances, and rate-limit window. Modal should also list "Most likely pool" and probability (e.g., accelerator 72%, standard 28%).

dmitri: Implementation plan: add POST /v1/preview/quota with body {tenant,principal,route,mode:"estimate|exact"}. Mode=estimate returns fast probabilistic routing scores from a precomputed model; mode=exact triggers fresh compute (slower). Cache estimate results aggressively. Return shape as flat fields: quota_effective, quota_breakdown[], routing_scores[], audit_id, computed_at.

ux-bot: ux-bot: design note: show a tiny sparkline in the badge representing quota burn for last 24h, hover opens the modal. Modal header: "Why this route is limited"; include CTA "Open audit trace". Keep default collapsed.

maya: Telemetry ask: we need to know whether customers used the preview to resolve support tickets. Events: preview.open, preview.api_hit, preview.estimate_used. Also tie audit_id -> logs so SRE can replay.

tonY: cache considerations: two caches: estimate-cache (TTL 10m) keyed by (tenant,route,principal,policy_digest), exact-cache (TTL 30s) for recent interactive uses. Pre-warm endpoints: POST /v1/preview/prewarm with list of (route,principal) for dashboards. Rate limit prewarm per-tenant.

dmitri: Edge cases: if policy change event arrives, invalidate both caches; include policy_digest in response so UI can warn if preview may be stale. Also add header X-Preview-Cache-Age.

rachel: UX nuance: avoid exposing raw percentages as probabilities of routing unless we add a confidence note. Instead show "Preferred pool: Accelerator (likely)" and allow "Show score" advanced option.

maya: Support procedures: when customers complain, support should ask for the audit_id from the preview modal. Add a quick copy button. Also include a tooltip explaining "effective quota" vs "configured quota".

infra-bot: infra-bot: feature-flag created: quota_preview_panel (default off). Canary rollout staged: 5% internal -> 25% beta -> 100% ramp.

dmitri: Dev tasks: 1) estimate model infra + precompute job, 2) preview API + cache keys, 3) prewarm endpoint, 4) telemetry schema. I can take 1+2.

tonY: Ops tasks: add dashboard for preview latency and cache hit ratio; alert if preview backend error rate > 1% for 5m. Also instrument preview.api_call with cost_estimate (compute ms + CPU).

rachel: Copy for modal header suggestion: "Effective quota and routing for this route. Click View audit trace to inspect rules that contributed to this result."

maya: Ok owners: dmitri (backend), tony (ops + infra rollout), rachel (product + copy), maya (support comms). Timeline: spike 5 days, internal dogfood 1 week, beta customers next. I'll file a support playbook after spike.

ux-bot: ux-bot: reminder: add accessibility labels for the badge and ensure modal is keyboard navigable.

maya: Great. Let's sync on Mon 10am to review the spike results.
